backend.reason: Zones and record sets are plain data the engine already holds, and the same code runs in Nano. Answers are served from that state by the engine's resolver (/azure-data/dns/query, console Test query). No shared CoreDNS exists in the stack yet (Route 53 / Cloud DNS are not built), so a new container would add idle memory for no extra fidelity; a CoreDNS file plugin can be added later as the shared backend if raw UDP/53 `dig` is wanted.
